# Clicking an inline grid header filter also sorts its column

## Context

The v13.3 polish pass exposed an unwanted sort while focusing a header filter. Grace reported it during the grid workflow read; Emmy independently reproduced it in Chrome on Engine `065915038d`. Current dev `5829f5d407` changes only the lockfile from that tree.

## The Problem

In `examples/grid/bigData`, enable `showHeaderFilter` on the firstname header, with column menus disabled. Before a native click into the empty input, `isSorted` is null. The click focuses the input but also changes it to ASC and installs a firstname/ASC sorter in the Store. No text was entered. A user trying to position the caret unexpectedly reorders records.

## The Architectural Reality

`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:onClick` excludes the menu trigger and resize handle, then always advances the sort state. The inline field created by `afterSetShowHeaderFilter` is a child of the same header button; its input, wrapper and field root are in the observed click ancestry.

Design authority: `learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md` describes header filters as “allowing users to filter data directly from the column headers”; its Sorting section separately describes a header click as the sorting gesture. This repair keeps interaction with the nested filter control from being interpreted as the sorting gesture, consistent with the existing menu-trigger exclusion.

## The Fix

Keep inline filter interactions inside that control at the header's sort-dispatch boundary. Cover the existing field root and its descendants, including nested operator/clear controls, without disabling ordinary header sorting or changing Store filter ownership. Add the regression to the existing `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderInlineProjectionNL.spec.mjs`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Clicking an empty or populated inline filter leaves the header sort state and Store sorters unchanged.
- [ ] Nested filter controls retain their filtering action without also sorting; typing still updates the inline contribution.
- [ ] A normal click on the header caption still sorts and toggles direction.
- [ ] A native browser regression fails on the current source and passes with the repair; existing inline projection coverage remains green.

## Out of Scope

Header layout/overflow, the new optional record-search toolbar, Table behavior, and the separately owned keyboard-navigation investigation.
